summary: The shared Codex and Claude Code team contract, runtime adapters, README guide, and evidence validator are ready for an independent release audit.
decisions: Use one neutral nine-role contract to render both Codex and Claude Code adapters.
Allow parallel writes only for Token Curator and Component Contract Author after file ownership is separated.
Use the checksum-verified Semantic OS graph embedded in docs/color-reference.md as color authority.

Require SHA-256 artifact evidence, gate exit codes, and valid role-stage transitions for every handoff.
